chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from Misma', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who forgot to pelt the Jamarat on the second day, so he began with the Jamarat al-Aqabah, then the middle one, then the first one; he should delay what he pelts with, and he should pelt the middle Jamarah, then the Jamarat al-Aqabah.

key_terms.رَمْيَ الْجِمَارِ: Pelt the Jamarat (throwing stones at pillars)

ai.seo_question: What is the correct procedure for making up missed Jamarat throws on the second day of Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the fiqh of *nasi* (forgetfulness) in Hajj rituals, specifically addressing the sequence of pelting the Jamarat when a pilgrim deviates from the standard order. It establishes that the missed throws must be performed in their original chronological sequence (Middle then Aqabah) to rectify the error, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on maintaining ritual integrity even in cases of inadvertent mistake. This ruling is often discussed in contrast to Sunni schools regarding whether the order is strictly obligatory or merely recommended for perfection.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Misma’a,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a man who forgot to pelt the Jamarah on the second day, so he began with the Al-Aqabah Jamarah, then ‘Al-Wusta’ the middle, then ‘Al-Ula’ the first one, (heasws said): ‘He should delay what he pelts with, and he should pelt Jamarah al-Wusta (the middle Jamarah), then the Al- Jamarah Al-Aqabah.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from Misma’ who has said the following: “This is about a man who due to forgetfulness on the second day first throws pe
bbles on Jamarah al-‘Aqabah’ then al-Wusta’ then al-’Ula’, Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ’He must reverse it by throwing pebbles on Jamarah al-Wusta’ then on Jamarah al-‘Aqabah’.’”
